# oblique_admin (Data Source)

Admins are the set of users responsible for managing Oblique. They have special permissions to own API objects that aren't explicitly owned by another user, team, or group. They are also responsible for system settings like integrations.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an existing admin assignment by its resource name. Useful for
# referencing admin records that were granted outside of this Terraform
# configuration (for example via the UI or by another module).
data "oblique_admin" "janedoe" {
  name = "admins/janedoe"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the admin API object. This is an arbitrary string and does not have to match the user's name.

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String) The time the admin was created.
- `id` (String) The ID is a computed type that always matches 'name'.
- `management` (Attributes) How this admin is managed. Set automatically by the server based on the calling client. Omitted from responses when the admin is manually managed (the default). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--management))
- `update_time` (String) The time the admin was last updated.
- `user` (String) The user that has been granted admin privileges.

Format: `users/{user}`

<a id="nestedatt--management"></a>
### Nested Schema for `management`

Read-Only:

- `manager` (String) How the API object is managed. Set automatically by the server based on the caller: Terraform clients produce `TERRAFORM`; for all other clients the management field is left unset on the response.
- `repo_dir` (String) Optionally, the subdirectory within `repo_uri` that holds the Terraform configuration for this API object. Populated by the Oblique Terraform provider.
- `repo_uri` (String) URI of the VCS repository that holds the Terraform configuration for this API object. Populated by the Oblique Terraform provider.
